source_acquisition.search_note: The proceedings PDF is the inventory fact source: 58 pages, 40 figures, 19 tables, and no numbered algorithms. The reading record and reports/tables/visual_source_inventory.csv select EricTan7/Veritas with exact title/README match and an explicit official PDF URL. The local visual-source inventory contains three acquired plotting scripts; GitHub repository view and recursive tree were checked on main at commit d384e81dc73f838a3a0c8c1a44d9b8976bd5788b. The scripts provide plotting conventions and related detector-analysis assets, but no paper-specific generator for all Figures 1–40 or Tables 1–19. Therefore source provenance is exact for the linked repository and available visual tooling, while each object’s final styling and contents are based on the rendered conference PDF. All 58 pages were rendered at 200 dpi (1700 x 2200 pixels) and inspected, including body, references, appendix, qualitative floats, and prompt-template pages.

paper_style.palette_strategy: The paper uses pastel blue, orange, green, gray, yellow, and lavender accents for detector/model cards, reasoning stages, and bar charts. Red text and marks highlight important artifacts, deltas, or reasoning depth. Main and appendix tables are mostly black-and-white with gray/blue row or cell fills and bold/underlined best values. Natural-image color in qualitative examples is local content rather than a quantitative scale.
paper_style.vector_raster_mix: The PDF is predominantly vector text, rules, prompt panels, and chart geometry, with embedded raster face/image thumbnails throughout Figures 1, 2, 6–7, 9, 11–27. Tables combine vector text and light fills; prompt figures are vector-like monospace panels. The 200 dpi renders preserve all objects, but dense reasoning cards, wide tables, and prompt text become difficult to read at normal page scale.
paper_style.style_consistency: Roman captions/body text, compact ICLR two-column layout, grayscale booktabs tables, and repeated colored reasoning cards are consistent. The quantitative figures reuse grouped bars and direct labels, while qualitative cards reuse tag vocabulary. Caption completeness, table widths, color semantics, and explicit definitions of prompt/metric abbreviations vary considerably.

figures.label: Figure 2

caption.text: Figure 2: Overview of HydraFake dataset. (a) We carefully collect and reimplement advanced deepfake techniques to construct our HydraFake dataset. Real images are collected from 8 datasets. Fake images are from classic datasets, high-quality public datasets and our self-constructed deepfake data. (b) We introduce a rigorous evaluation protocol. Training data contains abundant samples but limited forgery types. Evaluations are split into four levels. (c) Illustration of the subsets in different evaluation splits. (d) Performance of existing detectors. Most detectors generalize well on Cross-Model setting but perform poorly on Cross-Forgery and Cross-Domain scenarios.

figures.label: Figure 3

caption.text: Figure 3: Overview of two-stage training pipeline. (a) For Pattern-Guided Cold-Start, we first employ SFT to internalize thinking patterns. Then we introduce MiPO to facilitate human-aligned reasoning. The MiPO dataset consists of mixed non-preference data, encouraging the model to perform precise and fine-grained reasoning. (b) For Pattern-Aware GRPO, we introduce pattern-aware reward to incentivize adaptive reasoning ability on pattern granularity, yielding our VERITAS model.

cross_object_system.visual_narrative: The paper opens with a qualitative transparency contrast (Figure 1), introduces HydraFake provenance and evaluation splits (Figure 2), then explains two-stage training and pattern-aware annotation (Figures 3 and 9). Main ablations and reasoning quality/robustness (Figures 4–6 and Tables 1–8) lead to appendix protocol inventories, detailed benchmarks, efficiency/hyperparameter analyses, and extensive reasoning/prompt artifacts (Figures 7–40 and Tables 9–19).
cross_object_system.caption_system: Captions consistently give a Figure/Table label and title. Figure 2, Figure 3, Figure 9, Table 1, and Table 14 provide substantial setup or interpretation, while many qualitative and prompt captions only identify the artifact. Captions rarely define all abbreviations, sample selection, prompt version, or uncertainty semantics.
cross_object_system.table_header_system: Main performance tables use grouped dataset headers with Acc./P./R. subheaders and bold/underline best-value conventions. Ablations use compact split columns; appendix tables repeat the same method rows and grouped benchmark headers. Shape/protocol metadata uses row groups and booktabs-like horizontal rules. Color fills in Table 1 and Table 14 are semantic locally but not a complete global table system.
cross_object_system.method_result_ablation_link: Figure 3 and Figure 9 explain SFT, MiPO, P-GRPO, artifact taxonomy, and reasoning tags; Figures 4–5 and Tables 2–6 ablate training stages, patterns, reward components, model sizes, and non-preference data. Tables 1 and 7–8 and Figure 6 carry main outcome and reasoning-quality evidence. The method-to-result link is strong in prose but exact prompt/shape mappings are mostly appendix-only.
cross_object_system.main_appendix_link: Appendix Table 9 expands the dataset protocol behind Figure 2; Tables 10–16 expand main split, cross-benchmark, and efficiency results; Tables 17–19 test hyperparameters/data selection; Figures 7–27 provide dataset, mechanism, reasoning, transfer, and failure examples; Figures 28–40 preserve prompts. Cross-references are plentiful, but object captions often require appendix prose to decode IDs and conditions.
cross_object_system.typography_consistency: Figure captions use Roman text and code/prompt panels use monospace, but embedded card text ranges from comfortable to near-minimum size. Wide benchmark tables shrink body text below comfortable reading size while the same visual hierarchy is otherwise stable.
cross_object_system.color_consistency: Pastel card and bar colors recur for local roles, and red consistently emphasizes artifacts or deltas. Detector colors, split colors, and prompt/card fills are not a globally fixed semantic palette; natural-image color is non-semantic. Grayscale recovery is strongest in tables and weakest in qualitative cards.

most_reusable_patterns: Dataset overview combining source collection, evaluation protocol, split composition, and baseline behavior.
Two-stage training schematic with data, model, human/reward, and output objects aligned along a causal flow.
Cumulative line/grouped-bar ablations with direct value labels and a fixed split order.
Qualitative input-plus-tagged-reasoning cards paired with quantitative accuracy or reasoning-quality tables.
Boxed prompt artifacts that preserve exact output tags for reproducibility.
highest_value_objects: Figure 2: the dataset/protocol overview gives the core split logic and baseline gap in one view.
Figure 3: the two-stage training pipeline binds SFT, MiPO, P-GRPO, and reward flow.
Figure 9: the annotation taxonomy, staged generation, and examples make pattern-aware supervision concrete.
Table 1: the wide hierarchical benchmark table is the primary quantitative generalization evidence.
Figure 1 and Figure 6: qualitative reasoning cards make the transparency claim inspectable.
failure_patterns: Long qualitative reasoning and prompt cards are below comfortable page-scale readability.
Captions frequently omit sample selection, prompt/version details, fixed workload parameters, and uncertainty or run-count definitions.
Very wide benchmark tables require tiny typography and numerous abbreviations, limiting auditability.
Pastel colors provide local grouping but are not globally stable or reliably grayscale-safe.
Qualitative examples can illustrate faithfulness or failure but lack denominators and selection protocols.
final_judgment.one_sentence_visual_strategy: Veritas uses a progression from qualitative detector-output contrast to dataset/protocol and two-stage reasoning schematics, quantitative split-wise ablations, and a large appendix of reasoning/prompt artifacts, with strong explanatory intent but inconsistent scale, caption definitions, and global encoding semantics.
